narrative.overview: A well-kept ledger on a clean counter: neutral zinc surfaces, hairline borders, numbers that line up, and one violet that means act here. The theme is light only and every text pairing is measured to WCAG AA.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral zinc canvas, a single violet accent, a five-step traffic-light ramp for expiry only.
Border plus a barely-there shadow for elevation.
Geist for text, Geist Mono with tabular figures for data.
Status is always icon + word + colour.
Touch-first sizing (44px) that compacts to 36px from sm up.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet means act here. It is never used for status, decoration, or section colour.

rules.name: The Ramp Is Not A Palette Rule
rules.body: Red, orange, amber, sky, and emerald exist only to express expiry.

rules.name: The Measured Pair Rule
rules.body: A new foreground/background pairing is added to the contrast comment in globals.css with its ratio, in both themes, before it ships.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Data Rule
rules.body: Numbers that get compared use .font-data. Prose and labels never do.

rules.name: The Border Carries It Rule
rules.body: Depth at rest comes from the 1px border; the shadow is a whisper.

dos: Do use semantic tokens instead of raw colours.
Do pair every tier with its icon and word, via TierBadge.
Do set quantities, dates, and KPIs in .font-data.
Do keep touch targets at 44px on mobile and compact to 36px from sm.
Do keep transitions between 150 and 200ms and respect reduced motion.
Do add a measured contrast ratio to the globals.css comment for any new pairing, in both themes.
donts: Don't make pill buttons; pills are for status badges only.
Don't put raw hex or palette classes in components; use tokens.
Don't convey status by colour alone.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons; lucide only.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces beyond shadow-xs.
Don't spend violet on anything but action, focus, selection, and links.
